name: Air Pollution
description: Investigate trends in aerosol optical depth and nitrogen dioxide — indicators of smog and haze.

recommendation.reason: Aerosol optical depth (AOD) directly measures atmospheric haze, which is the signature of smog events in Punjab and Sindh.

name: Drought
description: Track soil moisture changes that signal wetting or drying trends in key regions.

recommendation.reason: Soil moisture shows how much water is stored in the ground; combining it with rainfall reveals whether drying trends are driven by less rain or more evaporation.

name: Rainfall Patterns
description: Explore how monsoon and seasonal rainfall is shifting across Pakistan's diverse regions.

recommendation.reason: GPM IMERG satellite rainfall shows how precipitation patterns differ between Pakistan's northern mountains and southern plains.

name: Climate Change
description: Examine long-term temperature trends using NASA reanalysis data.

recommendation.reason: MERRA-2 reanalysis temperature reveals how warming rates may differ between mountainous north and subtropical south.

name: Agriculture
description: Monitor vegetation health and growing conditions using satellite-derived greenness indices.

recommendation.reason: NDVI measures crop and vegetation greenness; together with soil moisture it reveals agricultural stress or improvement.

name: Forest Loss
description: Coming soon — Track deforestation trends using Hansen Global Forest Change data.

recommendation.reason: Forest loss analysis requires the Hansen dataset pipeline, which is not yet connected.

name: Ocean Health
description: Coming soon — Investigate sea surface temperature and ocean colour trends.
